description: 150kHz Step-down type Fixed 5V 2A SOIC-8 Voltage Regulators - DC DC Switching Regulators
notes: 2 A max output, 4.5-40 V input. At 5 V out this caps one LED module at 10 W regardless of what the controller supplies.

PROTECTION (datasheet p.1 features, p.7 electrical characteristics): thermal shutdown, switch current limit IL = 4 A (p.7, at VFB=0), and a 'second current limit' that drops switching from 150 kHz to 50 kHz. The 4 A limit is well above the 2.16 A a full-white 6x6 module draws, so it never trips in normal use.

THERMAL SHUTDOWN THRESHOLD IS NOT SPECIFIED. It appears in the feature list but has no min/typ/max and no test condition anywhere in the electrical characteristics. Treat it as a last-resort backstop of unknown trip point, not as a design parameter.

Output stage is bipolar, not MOSFET: output saturation voltage VCE = 1.2 V typ / 1.4 V max at Iout = 2 A (p.7). Conduction loss is therefore VCE x Iout x D, which falls as input voltage rises because the duty cycle shortens.

the 36 V bus this design actually uses: duty is 5/36 = 0.139, so IC conduction is 1.2 V x 2.16 A x 0.139 = 0.36 W and the catch diode carries the other 86%. Taking the split at 28 V gives duty 0.179 and does not apply to a 36 V contract.

RthJA = 100 C/W (SOIC-8, no heatsink, free air) and TJ max 125 C, so free-air dissipation is capped at 1.0 W at 25 C ambient. The 2 A rating is only reachable with real copper pour; a decent board reaches roughly 50-60 C/W.

Efficiency is specified only at Vin = 12 V (82% at 5 V out, 2 A). A 28 V bus is within the 40 V rating but well outside the characterised point, and efficiency falls there. Lower bus voltage is better for this part.

rules.note: datasheet p.7 test conditions use a 220uF/50V bulk capacitor across Vin and GND
